title: Live Production Cloudflare/VPS Deployment Verification, Domain Health & Founder Final Acceptance
objective: Verify the live production build and deploy pipeline, execute live sanity check against https://www.nihomi.com, verify live SSL, headers, and OAuth routing, and deliver the final commercial release dossier for Founder acceptance.
in_scope: Verify production build and deploy artifacts in dist/ (dist/server.cjs, dist/index.html)
Execute live health and sanity check probe against live production URL https://www.nihomi.com
Audit live domain response codes, V2 landing asset loading, SSL certificates, and Google OAuth callback redirect alignment
Verify zero client-side routing crashes or HTTP 405/500 errors on production environment
Publish final Founder Acceptance Dossier and release notes
out_of_scope: Modifying core curriculum lattice or introducing untaught vocabulary
Modifying production payment gateway secrets or database schemas without authorization
Unsolicited architectural rewrites or breaking API changes
acceptance_criteria: Production build produces clean dist/ artifacts with zero errors
Live production sanity check script confirms 200 OK on https://www.nihomi.com root and API health endpoints
SSL certificates and security headers valid on live domain
V2 routes resolve cleanly on live production environment
Comprehensive Founder Acceptance Dossier delivered with complete visual evidence and test credentials
verification: Manual mobile browser walkthrough by Founder
risks: Cloudflare Pages edge caching might serve stale HTML if cache-invalidation is delayed
Production DNS or third-party OAuth redirect URI mismatch if production env variables differ from local
